headline.text: L1 S1 metal washer deposited into pouch after M10 cleaning — *X-ray caught it*, metal detector did not reject. Investigation open.

summary: Two active holds — metal washer at L1 S1 and unsealed pouches at L2 FFS. L3 ML4 cold stamp plate failed all three microbial cleaning rounds; re-clean and re-test in progress. Hair found in L1 S1 product before enrober; hygiene coaching reinforced.

holds.title: Metal washer in pouch — M10 cone
holds.summary: X-ray rejected pouch containing washer from M10 cone; operator cleaned cone but did not replace washer, which fell into product stream during operation.
holds.status: Resolved — washer replaced on M10 cone, X-ray functioned correctly, rejected pouch isolated.

holds.title: Unsealed pouches — long seal failure
holds.summary: FFS long seal failed to seal completely after batch change to 68AUC; pouches open and not holding air.
holds.status: Resolved — affected product removed for rework, long seal moved 2mm and pressure adjusted, line released at 09:10 MT.

food_safety.title: Hair found in product — before enrober
food_safety.summary: Single hair found on west side of conveyor just before enrober; depositor operator and QA notified, hygiene coaching given (double hair nets, secure tie-back).
food_safety.status: Open — corrective action (double hat requirement) communicated to shift, monitoring ongoing.

food_safety.title: S4 belt scraping and peeling
food_safety.summary: Kitchen band showing scraping and peeling damage; maintenance notified to inspect for potential debris generation in food-contact zone.
food_safety.status: Open — maintenance investigating cause and extent of damage.

quality.title: Metal detector failure to open — S1
quality.summary: MD reading test cards correctly but reject gate not opening; significant buildup on belt identified as root cause.
quality.status: Resolved — production cleaned MD, maintenance adjusted belt, test cards pass and gate opens correctly as of 08:20 MT.

quality.title: ML2 broken bars — depositor/demolder
quality.summary: High rate of broken bars in molds before demold; chocolate too cold, plus nozzle and vibration issues.
quality.status: Resolved — operators purged nozzles, reduced vibration and demolder pressures, mold temp confirmed at 86.5°F, broken rate reduced to 1 per 5–6 molds by end of shift.

quality.title: M9 pouch shaker missing nut
quality.summary: First-shift operator found shaker securing nut missing; same operator had verified it tightened previous shift.
quality.status: Resolved — maintenance replaced nut and secured at 07:51 MT.

quality.title: Matrix 9 & 10 dirty plates causing weight drift
quality.summary: Significant product stuck to matrix plates causing weight issues; plates not cleaned between shifts.
quality.status: Resolved — matrices cleaned, weights back in spec.

sanitation.title: ML4 cold stamp plate microbial failures
sanitation.summary: Cold stamp plate failed all three rounds of environmental microbial testing; nozzle plate also showed issues.
sanitation.status: Open — plates disassembled, re-cleaned, dried, and swabbed; awaiting micro results. Plates sanitized after swab collection at 10:55 MT.

sanitation.title: Kitchen 1 floor left dirty by 2nd shift
sanitation.summary: LA kitchen 1 area floor dirty and full of food scraps at 3rd-shift arrival; 2nd shift did not complete end-of-shift cleaning.
sanitation.status: Open — 3rd-shift leader flagged issue for coaching.

sanitation.title: ML2 Sweco screen rice buildup
sanitation.summary: Rice buildup on Sweco screen; line stopped to replace screen mid-shift.
sanitation.status: Resolved — new screen installed and ATP passed; backup screen washed and ATP'd as spare.

opportunities.text: Consider adding washer/fastener verification to M9/M10 cleaning and reassembly checklist — based on today's M10 washer-in-product and M9 missing nut events.
Review end-of-shift cleaning sign-off for Kitchen 1 — based on floor left dirty with food scraps at shift handoff.
Review PTL-to-Sweco flush procedure on ML2 — based on rice carryover requiring mid-shift screen swap.
Evaluate ML4 cold stamp cleaning SOP effectiveness — based on three consecutive micro test failures on same component.
